description: The payments on account of a declaration that the VAT scheme a company recorded asks for during its period — a simplified scheme pays part of the year's tax before filing the annual return — with what was due, what was paid and what is outstanding. The schedule, the percentages and the box of the previous year they are read on are country pack data; no country rule lives in this tool. It reads; it pays nothing.

company_id.description: The company to work in. Ask list_companies if unsure.

from.description: First day of the period of the declaration the instalments are paid on account of — usually 1 January.

name: instalment_plan
title: VAT instalments of a period
